statements.text: I look forward to continuing to be a close partner with Sec. Wright over the next four years to expand American-made energy, win the AI race, and secure America's preeminence in new energy technologies and scientific breakthroughs.
statements.venue: Press release on Energy Secretary Wright's visit to Oak Ridge National Lab

statements.text: The race for global power is shifting to technology, with artificial intelligence leading the way. Tennessee is uniquely positioned and poised to do something that the Department of Energy wants to do and that the country needs.
So, taking those three, supercomputing, quantum computing, and AI computing, and putting them together is how we make sure that we can lead and win this AI race.

The rest of the world, our adversaries, are investing in this. I want the United States to dominate in that area. Whether it is energy, AI, pick the discipline, pick the endeavor, I want us to be in first place.

I can assure you that there will be no rate increases without going to the people and there will be no action taken without TVA going to the citizenry and to the stakeholders, EPB or local constituents and having a public forum for this.
statements.venue: WDEF interview on TVA rates and data centers
